# DockFlip landing leaves an active CSS transform transition

## Context

The hosted Brain-gated run [38329136878](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38329136878) at `72dd30789e` exposes two boundaries in `WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL`: its active-motion precondition can expire before resize begins, and a local replay that reaches resize observes residual transformed pane geometry after fixed staging is removed.

Root's exact-head replay, three attempts, reaches the active/fixed-stage precondition but fails the preview width oracle each time: Feed measures about 907.88px against its 904.1875px column. Its excess decays after release. Both panes' inline styles and fixed-stage classes are already cleared. The same remaining FLIP fraction predicts their other rect coordinates; that attribution was initially an inference.

A separate real-Chrome control isolates the browser mechanism: start a 280ms transform transition on a 100px element, wait 80ms, then clear transform/origin/transition inline styles in the current cleanup order. Chrome still reports a running transform transition and a 176.18px visual width. Suppressing the transition and flushing its animation state before restoring styles produces 100px and no transition.

## The Problem

Clearing inline presentation is insufficient to cancel an already-running CSS transition. A pointer can therefore reclaim flex layout while a residual FLIP effect still changes the pane's visual geometry. The existing witness also races the motion lifetime: its nominal admission sample follows several asynchronous reads and a 105ms dwell, but the Mouse sensor's 5px distance threshold has not been crossed yet. Both hosted attempts settle before that sample and never exercise resize.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `DockFlip.land` promises to instantly land host-scoped presentation before direct manipulation measures geometry; Main `DragDrop.onDragStart` calls `landFromPath` synchronously before `Resize.start`. The resolved `#17985` contract requires transform-inclusive panes to follow their nested column within 2px.

`src/main/addon/DockFlip.mjs` owns active cleanup, pending waits, exact inline-style snapshots and host scope. MotionSignal remains worker-side observability. This is not a reducer, recursive descendant-sizing or Group-supersession problem.

## The Fix

Restore the captured geometry while CSS transitions are suppressed, flush that restored state, then reinstate the caller's transition policy. This stops an active effect and prevents a new effect when landing interrupts the inverse frame. Preserve pre-existing inline values, unrelated animations, host scope, idempotence and interruption outcomes. Exercise the real transition lifecycle in a browser, with a negative control against the current cleanup.

Make the existing nested-column witness deliberately reach the real native admission boundary while fixed staging exists. Use the actual Mouse sensor and trusted pointer path; preserve the model, preview geometry, release, identity and Escape oracles. Do not fabricate motion flags, lengthen timeouts or loosen geometry tolerances.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DockFlip cleanup / land | existing DockFlip host-scoped lifecycle and inline snapshot | owner transitions stop before restored geometry is read; prior inline values return | missing motion remains a synchronous no-op; real-browser transition and lifetime controls |
| Native resize admission | Main DragDrop before Resize.start | controlled witness proves fixed staging before admission and clean computed geometry afterward | original no-op-landing negative control remains red |
| Nested preview and terminal | resolved `#17985` contract | shells within 1px, transform-inclusive panes within 2px; conserved pair and unchanged preview document; release/cancel unchanged | current and repaired full existing journey |

Decision Record impact: aligned with ADR 0029 §2.1; no persisted schema, operation or public API change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Real-browser red/green controls prove cleanup lands both the pending inverse frame and a running transition, including a pre-existing nonzero transition policy, while restoring the exact prior inline presentation.
- [ ] The Workstation witness proves actual active-stage native admission, rather than racing a prior motion sample.
- [ ] The existing nested-column journey passes with its original width, topology, identity, release and Escape assertions.
- [ ] Existing DockFlip and Main admission lifecycle/order controls remain green.
- [ ] A source-bound hosted receipt discharges the nested-column quarantine; remaining ten-shard rollout stays owned by #19657.

## Out of Scope

The FiveBeat preview flip diagnosis, grid font parity already repaired in #19704, Group projection revision fencing, archive provisioning, and broader animation architecture.

## Avoided Traps

Restoring style strings as proof of cancelled effects; treating an expired precondition as a MotionSignal bug; widening tolerances; assigning recursive pixel widths to panes; cancelling another host's animation.
